meta.title: Autorestart — restart continuation
meta.description: Keeps agent work alive across a DeepSeek Harness restart: a durable checkpoint, goal re-arm or a continuation message on boot, and an idle-aware graceful restart the agent can request itself.

backupChoice.title: Automatic pre-restart backup: include the installed plugins too?
backupChoice.body: A snapshot of the current configuration is taken before every restart, so a host that fails to come back can be rolled back automatically.
backupChoice.withPluginsHint: About 3 seconds and 117 MB more; a plugin that breaks the boot can be rolled back too.
backupChoice.configOnlyHint: Instant, about 66 KB; plugin problems cannot be rolled back and need a manual reinstall.
backupChoice.footnote: You can change this later in Settings → Plugins → dsh-autorestart
